newsitem.title: FRANCE: RUGBY UNION-DOURTHE OUT OF FRANCE TEAM.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-DOURTHE OUT OF FRANCE TEAM.

text.p: Dax centre Richard Dourthe has withdrawn from France's side to meet Ireland in their opening Five Nations championship match in Dublin on Saturday.
Stephane Glas of Bourgoin will replace Dourthe, who was knocked out during France's late training session on Thursday and suffered concussion.
Given the proximity of the match, coach Jean-Claude Skrela decided it was too risky to allow Dourthe to play, although he made a quick recovery.
It is a considerable blow to France given Dourthe's strengths as a penetrating centre and defender as well as place kicker. Thomas Castaignede takes over the place kicking.
Laurent Leflamand, already in Ireland with the France A team, will take the vacant place on the bench.
